expectation: Cytoplasmic/granular MPO in neutrophils (and some monocytes): a sparse subset of discrete, cell-sized bright cells scattered as single cells or small clusters, often near vessels or inflamed foci, with most cells negative.
observed: A: sparse discrete yellow cell-sized spots, strongly varying between tissue pieces, with dense clusters in two pieces and near-empty others. B/C: compact bright cell-sized blobs on dark background, some small clusters, not following nuclear density. D: a clumpy cytoplasmic-like cell next to dim nuclei.
why: A distinct sparse subset of cell-sized, bright, compact cells with clustering in some regions, and a clean background, fits neutrophil MPO.
